title: Amazon Will Give Tariff Refunds to Some Customers - CNET
summary: Olsavsky said there were “a limited set of circumstances” where customers had to pay tariff charges on their items. “When we receive those refunds, we will proactively contact affected customers and automatically issue refunds to them,” he said.
